title: Ship Pipeline
description: Workflow template defining a DAG of steps for job execution.

globList.description: List of glob patterns. Pipe-separated strings (e.g. "a|b") are rejected — split into separate entries.

gateRuleList.description: Canonical: a list of gate rule objects. The legacy single-object shorthand was removed in the v1 contract freeze.

name.description: Pipeline identifier. Matches the filename without extension.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this pipeline does.

auto_merge.description: When true, the runtime runs `git merge` on the job branch after the final step. Replaces the former `type: merge` step.

vars.description: Pipeline-level default vars for `{{ var }}` template interpolation.

step_specs.description: Per-step spec bodies. Indexed by step position; written to `.artifacts/pipeline/NN-<step_id>.md` at launch.

steps.description: Ordered list of pipeline steps forming a DAG.

items.description: When `type` is omitted it is inferred: `run:` shorthand implies `run`; otherwise `agent`. `name:` is accepted as an alias for `id:`.

id.description: Unique step identifier within the pipeline.

name.description: Alias for `id:` accepted by the deserializer.

type.description: Step type. `agent` runs an agent, `review` is an agent-backed reviewer of the previous step, `run` executes a shell command. The legacy `merge` and `human` variants were removed in the v1 contract freeze; use `auto_merge: true` for merge and emit `job.blocked { needs_human: true }` from a step for human handoff. Optional — inferred from `run:` vs `agent:` shorthand when absent.

agent.description: Agent profile ID. Required for `agent` and `review` steps.

goal.description: Goal or instruction for the agent (templated).

after.description: Step IDs that must complete before this step runs. Empty = root step.

command.description: Shell command to run. Aliased as `run:` for YAML shorthand.

run.description: YAML shorthand for `command:`. Implies `type: run` when set.

max_retries.description: Maximum number of retries when the step's diff gate fails. 0 or absent = gate failure is terminal.

gate.description: Post-step diff gate. Evaluated against the files changed by this step's commits.

produces.description: Artifacts this step produces. The agent uploads them and reports their IDs in step_done.outputs.

name.description: Logical name, unique within this step. Used in consumes and promotes references.

scope.description: Storage scope. `run` is ephemeral (default); `project` and `user` are persistent.

required.description: When true, the step fails if this output is absent from step_done.outputs.

consumes.description: Names of outputs from prior steps this step depends on. Resolved by the orchestrator before dispatch and written to .artifacts/input/<name>.

promotes.description: Outputs to promote to a wider scope when this step succeeds.

name.description: Must match a produces.name on this step.

target_scope.description: Target scope. Valid transitions: run→project, run→user, project→user.
